mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic contraction in consumer and business sectors, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1.0%, persistent accommodative policy supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC for low-rate regime is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it signals residential sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST < 900.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates policy response to economic slowdown, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows at over 1.5% annually, robust manufacturing activity supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO 12m growth > 1.5%, or Rank IC for high-growth regime is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.
